name: ModelVariant133_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant133_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a fan of quads between two rings opens and closes around a slot part, then the screen flashes and shells of boxes and sparks burst from the ring); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, builds the ring points and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 once when the shells start, 2 once the sparks end and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-150 and 280 images build it with a 256-line flash. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
